title: Handwired — @_chenglou
note: Normal JavaScript converted to a neural net with hand-written weights — no training, exact outputs, in-browser. Demos include a mini OS with overlapping windows and a Learned Gallery where dragging rectangles auto-aligns photos in real time. Her steals: a Learned Gallery playground with a snap/looseness slider, and a portfolio-as-mini-OS homepage. Demo: https://chenglou.me/handwired/ — source: https://github.com/chenglou/handwired
